subject: david-d
body: Bug in R1-P-prompt (yours, advisor.history_text): it reads <researcher>/choices.jsonl + corpus/, but the personal track (trackp) writes seed_choices.jsonl and history.jsonl (the fit's history+val), so R1-P-prompt gets no personal history at all. Suggest history_text also read history.jsonl when present (it holds Choice rows: context, a_text, b_text, chosen). Found while rebuilding trackp seed items; I haven't touched advisor.py.
